prompt: I have a legacy Flask Sudoku app. Before refactoring, help me set up pytest tests that verify the home page loads and the current Sudoku board renders correctly.
Help me create a Sudoku solver in Python that can count solutions and confirm a generated Sudoku puzzle has exactly one unique solution.
Help me add a Top 10 Sudoku scoreboard using browser localStorage that saves player name, time, and difficulty.
Help me style a Flask Sudoku board with responsive CSS, light and dark mode support, and alternating colors for each 3x3 Sudoku square.
